FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the free billing audit?

It's a no-cost, no-obligation analysis of your billing efficiency. A certified expert reviews your current claims, denials and revenue cycle, then shares a preliminary analysis with the immediate opportunities we find to improve your practice's profitability.

How quickly will someone respond after I reach out?

A certified ProtoMed billing expert will follow up within 24 hours — one business day — to review your practice's specific needs and answer your questions.

Do I need to switch the billing system I already use?

No. Our team operates natively within your current EHR/EMR, so onboarding requires no complicated integrations and causes no disruption to your daily clinical routines.

Is my practice and patient data secure?

Yes. Data security is our top priority. We are 100% HIPAA compliant and hold industry-leading certifications to protect your practice and your patients' information at every step.

Which medical specialties do you work with?

We provide specialty-specific billing for more than 30 medical specialties — from cardiology and orthopedics to family practice, mental health and surgery centers — each handled to its own coding rules and payer guidelines.

Am I committing to anything by contacting you?

Not at all. Reaching out and claiming your free billing audit carries no commitment and no obligation. It's simply a chance to see how much more your practice could be collecting.

Your Revenue. Our Expertise. Total Confidence.
